# Unseen capsule public extension fixture

Disposable second consumer of the frozen ordinary extension API. It is never part of default production assembly. The extension imports only `@kite-ai/agent/extensions`; its separately built host uses public Agent, SQLite, Artifact, Service, Client and fixed AI exports. Construction performs no I/O. The test builds every package from its real manifest into a directory outside the source tree and runs without TypeScript source fallback.

The required Tool publishes a complete input Artifact, persists an immutable executable request, registers a completion requirement, ensures an independently authorized original Job and persists its original operation reference. A real owned Node process writes a deterministic capsule and an external effect ledger. The parent publishes the complete output Artifact only after the exact producer succeeds with matching bytes and digest. The condition permits that exact producer's own completion boundary; the parent Tool and Run still require its successful result proof. This avoids a circular obligation without exempting unrelated producers.

Ordinary `stage` prepares by reading the original request identity, then CAS creates it and starts a detached Job. `collect` waits only for that original operation and verifies bytes. `accept` CAS updates the acknowledgement for the exact result revision. `cancel` targets only the persisted original operation. Query reads persisted records and executions, with scoped Artifact references; it never starts a worker. Recovery observation never starts a replacement worker and treats an unconfirmed live PID as unavailable.

The public test uses original SDK Interaction decisions for each Tool, Action and Job. It verifies complete bodies above 64 KiB, mutable acknowledgement, two detached producers, exact cancellation, readonly process reconstruction with unchanged cursor/ledger and zero Model/worker calls, denied zero effects, and a missing condition implementation retaining the original completion obligation. A real project-source file changed after the Job's independent Ask rejects its adapter while preserving the already-dispatched parent's authorized record write.

The complete Store/Service host is Bun. Node loads the built public extension and runs the external worker; this does not claim a Node SQLite Store host. The suite covers concrete E01/E02/E14 and the missing-condition part of E05, plus a bounded E07 cancellation case. It does not establish every E01–E14 recipe, three abrupt deferred-worker kill windows, nested composition or notification-loss recovery.

Verification: `bun test tests/isolated/unified-agent/extension-unseen.test.ts` and `bunx tsc --noEmit -p tests/fixtures/extensions/unseen-capsule/tsconfig.json`. The final five-case qualification made 294 assertions. Historical failed logs, including the prepare-read lifecycle failure before the Host repair, remain under `/private/tmp/kite-extension-unseen-*`; the successful packet is `/private/tmp/kite-extension-unseen-public-thirteen-final.log`.
